examples.chinese: 晚安！希望你有個好夢。
examples.pinyin: Wǎn'ān! Xīwàng nǐ yǒu ge hǎo mèng.
examples.english: Good night! I hope you have a good dream.

items.wordHook: 晚(evening) + 安(peaceful) → a peaceful evening to you: 晚安 is good night.

examples.chinese: 現在幾點鐘？
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎnzhōng?
examples.english: What time is it now?

examples.chinese: 你幾點去學校？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qù xuéxiào?
examples.english: What time do you go to school?

examples.chinese: 你幾點去圖書館？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐdiǎn qù túshūguǎn?
examples.english: What time will you go to the library?

examples.chinese: A：現在幾點？ B：現在十點二十五分。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? B: Xiànzài shí diǎn èrshíwǔ fēn.
examples.english: A: What time is it now? B: It’s 10:25.

examples.chinese: 你幾點下課？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
examples.english: What time do you get out of class?

examples.chinese: 你昨天幾點回家？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān jǐ diǎn huí jiā?
examples.english: What time did you go home yesterday?

examples.chinese: 宜文昨天幾點睡覺？
examples.pinyin: Yíwén zuótiān jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?
examples.english: What time did Yiwen go to sleep yesterday?

examples.chinese: 一枝筆幾塊錢？
examples.pinyin: Yì zhī bǐ jǐ kuài qián?
examples.english: How much is a pen?

examples.chinese: 你的房間裡有幾張椅子？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān lǐ yǒu jǐ zhāng yǐzi?
examples.english: How many chairs are there in your room?

examples.chinese: 我有幾個臺灣朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge Táiwān péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have a few Taiwanese friends.

examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 友美，這幾個句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, zhè jǐ ge jùzi de yìsi wǒ bú tài dǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: Youmei, I don’t quite understand these sentences. Could you teach me?

examples.chinese: 你今天要買什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān yào mǎi shénme?
examples.english: What would you like to buy today?

examples.chinese: 我要買蛋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi dàn.
examples.english: I want to buy eggs.

examples.chinese: 我要去買禮物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù mǎi lǐwù.
examples.english: I am going to buy gifts.

examples.chinese: 我要買大蛋糕，不要買小蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi dà dàngāo, bú yào mǎi xiǎo dàngāo.
examples.english: I want to buy a big cake, not a small one.

examples.chinese: 我想買兩本中文書、一本英文書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, yì běn Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: I want to buy two books in Chinese and a book in English.

examples.chinese: 我們一起去買，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù mǎi, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: How about we go get them together?

examples.chinese: 我想買一些花和一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yìxiē huā hé yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: I would like to buy her some flowers and a big cake.

examples.chinese: 你要買什麼東西？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào mǎi shénme dōngxi?
examples.english: What stuff are you going to buy?

examples.chinese: 我要買這本書，不要買那本書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi zhè běn shū, bú yào mǎi nà běn shū.
examples.english: I want to buy this book, not that one.

examples.chinese: 好，我們買白的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen mǎi bái de.
examples.english: Okay, we go for the white one.

examples.chinese: 我們買兩枝，好不好？兩枝五十塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi liǎng zhī, hǎo bù hǎo? Liǎng zhī wǔshí kuài qián.
examples.english: How about we buy two of them? Two for 50NT dollars.

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
examples.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

examples.chinese: 這枝筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
examples.english: This pen is too expensive, you had better buy a cheaper one.

examples.chinese: 我要買一張桌子跟四張椅子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn sì zhāng yǐzi.
examples.english: I want to buy one table and four chairs.

examples.chinese: 我想買一台電視機。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì tái diànshìjī.
examples.english: I would like to buy a television.

examples.chinese: 我要買一部新電腦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yí bù xīn diànnǎo.
examples.english: I want to buy a new computer.

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 妳知道去哪裡買這個牌子的衣服嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào qù nǎlǐ mǎi zhè ge páizi de yīfu ma?
examples.english: Do you know where you can get this clothing brand?

examples.chinese: 我很想去看，可是我最近胖了五公斤，我怕衣服不好買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kàn, kěshì wǒ zuìjìn pàng le wǔ gōngjīn, wǒ pà yīfu bù hǎo mǎi.
examples.english: I would like to check it out. But I have recently gained 5 kilograms, so I am worried that they don’t have my size.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 是啊，我想買一雙黑色的。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng hēisè de.
examples.english: Yes, I would like to buy a pair of black ones.

examples.chinese: 電梯在那裡！我們現在去買。
examples.pinyin: Diàntī zài nàlǐ! Wǒmen xiànzài qù mǎi.
examples.english: There is the elevator! Let’s go get them now.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

examples.chinese: 你媽媽真漂亮！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ māma zhēn piàoliàng!
examples.english: Your mom is really beautiful!

examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 元真，妳的這條裙子真好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, nǐ de zhè tiáo qúnzi zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: Yuanzhen, your skirt is very beautiful; I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 這課真的不好學。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè zhēnde bù hǎo xué.
examples.english: This chapter is really difficult to learn.

examples.chinese: 原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēnde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: Oh! You are talking about the Chinese animal zodiac! It’s really interesting.

examples.chinese: 真的啊？好有趣！
examples.pinyin: Zhēnde ā? Hǎo yǒuqù!
examples.english: Really? So interesting!

items.wordHook: a 十(ten) 具(tool) kit counted complete on the table → 真(really).

examples.chinese: 很多大學生利用暑假去國外旅行或是學語言。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng lìyòng shǔjià qù guówài lǚxíng huòshì xué yǔyán.
examples.english: Many college students use summer vacation to travel abroad or learn languages.

examples.chinese: 很多大學生都打過工，因為得自己付生活費。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng dōu dǎ guò gōng, yīnwèi děi zìjǐ fù shēnghuófèi.
examples.english: Many university students have had part-time jobs because they have to pay their own living expenses.

examples.chinese: 畢業後能順利找到好工作，是很多大學生的希望。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè hòu néng shùnlì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò, shì hěn duō dàxuéshēng de xīwàng.
examples.english: Being able to smoothly find a good job after graduation is the hope of many university students.

examples.chinese: 許多大學生參加愛心服務的社團，幫助老人打掃環境。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō dàxuéshēng cānjiā àixīn fúwù de shètuán, bāngzhù lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng.
examples.english: Many university students join volunteer service clubs to help the elderly clean up the environment.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.
examples.english: Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old.

examples.chinese: 你經過便利商店的時候，可以幫我買一瓶水嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīngguò biànlì shāngdiàn de shíhou, kěyǐ bāng wǒ mǎi yì píng shuǐ ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the convenience store, can you buy a bottle of water for me?

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 我的漢字考試總是不及格，經過三個月努力地練習，終於及格了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànzì kǎoshì zǒngshì bù jígé, jīngguò sān ge yuè nǔlì de liànxí, zhōngyú jígé le.
examples.english: I always fail my Chinese character exams; after three months of hard practice, I finally passed.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
examples.pinyin: Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.
examples.english: The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 每次看到有河流經過的都市，就會想起我生長的家鄉。
他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
我逛街時經過了一排小吃攤，就買幾樣回來當作宵夜。
經過我的說明，他反而有些糊塗了，看來我的解釋不太清楚。
經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
早上在草地上散步，突然看見一條蛇經過，害得我一直流冷汗。
經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
經過多次訓練，他總算贏得這場球賽的冠軍。
這家民宿的旁邊就是美麗的海邊，風景美極了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù de pángbiān jiù shì měilì de hǎibiān, fēngjǐng měi jí le.
examples.english: Right next to this guesthouse is a beautiful beach; the scenery is extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 這家民宿的旁邊就是美麗的海邊，風景美極了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù de pángbiān jiù shì měilì de hǎibiān, fēngjǐng měi jí le.
examples.english: Right next to this guesthouse is a beautiful beach; the scenery is extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 台灣的周圍都是海，還有不少美麗的海灘。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de zhōuwéi dōu shì hǎi, hái yǒu bùshǎo měilì de hǎitān.
examples.english: Taiwan is surrounded by sea, and there are also many beautiful beaches.

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

examples.chinese: 天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。
examples.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu wúshù ge xīngxing, jù zài yìqǐ jiù biànchéng le měilì de yínhé.
examples.english: There are countless stars in the sky; gathering together, they become the beautiful Milky Way.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.
examples.english: On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 我國四季都有美麗的風景：春季時平原有花海、夏季時海灘有日出、秋季時山區有紅樹、冬季時高山有白雪，都十分迷人。
我大哥去年娶了英國太太，我們都好喜歡這位美麗的大嫂。
錢小姐戴的那副耳環就像星光一樣美麗，聽說那是祖母留給她的回憶。
他利用石頭、木頭在山上建了一間美麗的小屋。
當我們爬上那座高山，看見美麗的日出時，大家都驚訝地張大了嘴巴。
我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng. Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english: My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping. For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 正常的生活作息，對身體和心理健康都很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngcháng de shēnghuó zuòxī, duì shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ jiànkāng dōu hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: A normal daily schedule is very important for both physical and mental health.

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 青少年期的心理變化相當大，需要父母及老師多關心。
如果遇到無法處理的心理問題，最好請專業人員來輔導。
有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 這種化妝品是針對東方人的皮膚設計的，在臺灣賣得很好。
為了練習英文的聽力和會話，我每天都跟美國朋友聊天。
examples.pinyin: Wèile liànxí Yīngwén de tīnglì hé huìhuà, wǒ měi tiān dōu gēn Měiguó péngyǒu liáotiān.
examples.english: In order to practice English listening and conversation, I chat with American friends every day.

examples.chinese: 林老師在日文系教書，他教的是二年級的日語會話。
examples.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī zài Rìwén xì jiāoshū, tā jiāo de shì èr niánjí de Rìyǔ huìhuà.
examples.english: Teacher Lin teaches in the Japanese department; what he teaches is second-year Japanese conversation.

examples.chinese: 那家貿易公司跟美國做生意，職員都得會說英文。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā màoyì gōngsī gēn Měiguó zuò shēngyì, zhíyuán dōu děi huì shuō Yīngwén.
examples.english: That trade company does business with America, so the employees all have to be able to speak English.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 中國與美國之間的貿易問題很嚴重，這個新聞早就上電視了。
我聽見樓下有奇怪的聲音，是不是有小偷啊？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn lóuxià yǒu qíguài de shēngyīn, shìbushì yǒu xiǎotōu a?
examples.english: I hear a strange sound downstairs—is there a thief?

examples.chinese: 當周圍環境很靜的時候，可以聽見平常聽不到的聲音。
在大都市，早上起床能聽見鳥叫聲，那真是太難得了。
聽見他欣賞的那位歌星來演唱的消息，令他興奮地跳了起來。
我聽見有人在敲門，你去看看是誰來了。
這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
筆電的價格和功能，都會影響顧客的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Bǐdiàn de jiàgé hé gōngnéng, dōu huì yǐngxiǎng gùkè de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The price and functions of laptops both influence customers' choices.

examples.chinese: 吃太多炸的東西，對身體會有不好的影響。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō zhà de dōngxi, duì shēntǐ huì yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Eating too much fried food will have a bad influence on your health.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，孔子是地位最高、最偉大的老師，他的思想影響了很多人。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, Kǒngzǐ shì dìwèi zuì gāo, zuì wěidà de lǎoshī, tā de sīxiǎng yǐngxiǎng le hěn duō rén.
examples.english: For Chinese people, Confucius is the teacher with the highest position and the greatest, and his thoughts have influenced many people.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。
examples.pinyin: Rénkǒu zēngjiā bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng shēnghuó pǐnzhí, kǒngpà yě huì zàochéng shíwù quēfá de wèntí.
examples.english: Population increase not only affects the quality of life, but恐怕 also causes the problem of food shortage.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 廚師們都會好好保養他們的用具，以免影響做菜的品質。
不論是工業或家庭廢水，對人們的健康都有不好的影響。
樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
林老師是我的高中導師，在學習上也是影響我最深的人。
想小便的時候千萬別忍耐，否則對健康的影響相當大。
人的性格主要是受成長環境的影響，跟性別沒有太大的關係。
根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
在歷史上，每次革命都對社會造成非常大的影響。
隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
保存食物的方式會影響食物的新鮮程度。
何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 這件大衣的設計很簡單，可是穿起來很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn dàyī de shèjì hěn jiǎndān, kěshì chuān qǐlái hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The design of this coat is very simple, but it looks good when you put it on.

examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
你把廣告設計得那麼小，這樣的宣傳怎麼有效果呢？
工廠排水系統得設計好，以免汙染自然環境。
離我家不遠的劇院，是請著名設計師來設計的。
那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
學校的布告欄總是隨著季節改變而有不同的設計。
戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
這種化妝品是針對東方人的皮膚設計的，在臺灣賣得很好。
設計師利用上電視的機會，展示他今年設計的服裝。
這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
每面國旗都代表一個國家，而且設計上都具有獨特的意義。
為了吸引人才，廣告企業提供獎金給優秀的設計師。

items.wordHook: Combining 設(build) and 計(calculate): 設計 means design.

examples.chinese: 我平常喜歡喝茶，有（的）時候喝一點兒咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng xǐhuān hē chá, yǒu (de) shíhou hē yìdiǎnr kāfēi.
examples.english: I usually like drinking tea. Sometimes I drink a little coffee.

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我現在不餓，只想吃一點兒水果。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài bú è, zhǐ xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: I am not hungry now, I just want some fruit.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 那家店的冰淇淋很好吃，可是有點兒貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.english: That store has delicious ice cream, but it is a bit expensive.

examples.chinese: 現在十二點半。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shí'èr diǎn bàn.
examples.english: It is half past twelve.

examples.chinese: A：你想點什麼？ B：我想點一碗牛肉麵。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiǎng diǎn shénme? B: Wǒ xiǎng diǎn yì wǎn niúròu miàn.
examples.english: A: What would you like to order? B: I want to order a bowl of beef noodles.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的甜點很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tiándiǎn hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This restaurant has delicious desserts.

examples.chinese: 我想喝一點兒飲料。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē yìdiǎnr yǐnliào.
examples.english: I would like to have a little drink.

examples.chinese: 甜的點心叫甜點。
examples.pinyin: Tián de diǎnxīn jiào tiándiǎn.
examples.english: Sweet snacks are called dessert.

examples.chinese: 宜文昨天幾點睡覺？
examples.pinyin: Yíwén zuótiān jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?
examples.english: What time did Yiwen go to sleep yesterday?

examples.chinese: 我今天七點起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I get up at 7:00 today.

examples.chinese: 你昨天幾點回家？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān jǐ diǎn huí jiā?
examples.english: What time did you go home yesterday?

examples.chinese: A：現在幾點？ B：現在十點二十五分。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? B: Xiànzài shí diǎn èrshíwǔ fēn.
examples.english: A: What time is it now? B: It’s 10:25.

examples.chinese: 我八點十分去學校。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn shí fēn qù xuéxiào.
examples.english: I go to school at 8:10.

examples.chinese: 你幾點去圖書館？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐdiǎn qù túshūguǎn?
examples.english: What time will you go to the library?

examples.chinese: 你幾點去學校？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qù xuéxiào?
examples.english: What time do you go to school?

examples.chinese: 現在幾點鐘？
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎnzhōng?
examples.english: What time is it now?

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有點兒難，我也不太懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒudiǎnr nán, wǒ yě bú tài dǒng.
examples.english: It is a little bit difficult; I don’t quite understand them, either.

examples.chinese: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
examples.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

examples.chinese: 可是從四點到五點半我要上英文課，六點去，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì cóng sì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn bàn wǒ yào shàng Yīngwén kè, liù diǎn qù, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: But I have an English class from 4 to 5:30 p.m. How about 6 p.m.?

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有一點兒累，我想回家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎnr lèi, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā xiūxí.
examples.english: I am feeling a bit tired, I want to go home for a rest.

examples.chinese: 這兩天天氣有點兒冷，我們週末去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, wǒmen zhōumò qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is a bit cold those two days. How about we do it this weekend?

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 小姐，我們要點兩碗牛肉麵和兩杯茶。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒmen yào diǎn liǎng wǎn niúròu miàn hé liǎng bēi chá.
examples.english: Miss, we would like to order two bowls of beef noodles and two cups of tea.

examples.chinese: 咖啡、茶，我都喜歡。我也很餓，想吃一點兒東西。
examples.pinyin: Kāfēi, chá, wǒ dōu xǐhuān. Wǒ yě hěn è, xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
examples.english: Coffee and tea, I like them both. I am also hungry; I would like to have some food.

examples.chinese: 謝謝！明天晚上六點來我家，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān wǎnshang liù diǎn lái wǒ jiā, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: Thanks! How about coming to my place at 6 p.m. tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

examples.chinese: 你幾點下課？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
examples.english: What time do you get out of class?

examples.chinese: 我四點四十分下課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ sì diǎn sìshí fēn xiàkè.
examples.english: I get out of class at 4:40.

items.wordHook: a 黑(black) brush 占(occupy) the paper → one 點(point).

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 如果能好好利用食物材料，就能有效地減少廚餘。
為了更有效地利用地球資源，我寧願減少不必要的生活享受。
有人說，這個世界是上帝創造的，你相信嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒurén shuō, zhège shìjiè shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de, nǐ xiāngxìn ma?
examples.english: Some people say that this world was created by God; do you believe it?

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
有時一個人的前途無法先規劃好，必須自己創造。
他在超市隨手買了瓶飲料，回家後才發現有效日期快到了，只好趕快喝完。
這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
鵝一看到陌生人就會大叫，所以鄉村裡有人把鵝當成狗來看家(kānjiā， to guard the house)。
我們公司的大型宴會活動，一向是宣傳部門負責處理的。
有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
在表演以前準備得越多，上舞臺就越有自信。
出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

items.wordHook: Combining 自(self) and 信(trust): 自信 means self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
雖然現在網路很普遍了，還是有不少人喜歡聽電臺的節目。
上課光聽老師教是沒用的，還要親自練習幾遍。
夏天時，在臺灣、日本、菲律賓都有颱風，這是很普遍的現象。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān shí, zài Táiwān, Rìběn, Fēilǜbīn dōu yǒu táifēng, zhè shì hěn pǔbiàn de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: In summer, there are typhoons in Taiwan, Japan, and the Philippines; this is a very common phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 你唱的這首歌真好聽，可以請你再唱一遍嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chàng de zhè shǒu gē zhēn hǎotīng, kěyǐ qǐng nǐ zài chàng yī biàn ma?
examples.english: This song you sang is really nice; could I ask you to sing it one more time?

items.wordHook: Through tireless 辶(movement) across town, posting signs upon each wooden 扁(board) all around → 遍(everywhere).

examples.chinese: 對顧客來說，品牌代表了對公司服務的印象以及商品的品質。
很多人購物不在乎商品的品牌，只要耐用就好。
這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。
我新學的舞蹈很複雜，常忘了什麼時候前進或後退。
腦部血管很複雜，做腦部手術時不能有任何的差錯。
我話先說在前頭，要是你不照他所說的去做，等後頭出了問題，情況可就更複雜了。
雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
今天王醫師門診，沒有護理師協助，什麼事都得自己動手。
根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。

items.wordHook: Combining 主(master) and 角(angle): 主角 means leading role character, role.
a 人(person) checks a map and points the route → 以(according to).
a 勹(wrap) holds a 口(mouth) snugly → one short 句(sentence).
右(right) + 邊(side) → the right side: 右邊.
An able 可(kě) youth stands tall above his siblings as their dependable 哥(elder brother).
一(one) plank is placed 丄(above) the frame → sturdy 工(labor).
a 口(mouth) swallows 一(one) ray of light → 日(day).
Combining 暫(temporary) and 時(time): 暫時 means temporarily.
a 木(tree) shelf takes a 旦(dawn) lamp → ready to 查(look up) the answer.
an 矢(arrow) flies straight to the 口(mouth) → the truth you 知(know).
A young child who will 立(stand) tall in the village 里(village) is a playful 童(child).
Combining 肩(shoulders) and 膀(shoulder): 肩膀 means shoulder.
a 艹(herb) crushed into a 樂(music) box makes 藥(medications).
Combining 面(face) and 紙(paper): 面紙 means facial paper.
A feathered body takes wing, its 灬(fire) tail feathers flaring like sparks → 鳥(bird).
